label: Pre-copy phase (original tokens + <DEL>)
explanation: Broad phase feature: fires on nearly every original-phase input step (rate ~0.96 for orig_idx 1-7) and on the <DEL> step (rate 0.88), and is essentially silent throughout the copy phase (rate 0.003, ~0 mass). Token identity barely matters for whether it fires. Magnitude is modulated by position: weak at t=0 (rate 0.60, mean ~0.16), largest at early-middle original positions (t=2-4, mean ~1.6), moderate on <DEL> (~1.15), and smaller in late original positions. Inputs k and 2 early in the sequence are associated with the highest activations (top examples are dominated by k/2 prefixes; in_tok 2 carries ~1.8x its share of mass). Misses are mostly weak t=0 steps that the predicate counts as positive; the copy-phase activations it misses are rare and tiny.

issues: The explanation says the input token barely affects whether the feature fires, and that the t=0 false positives are 'weak or absent' steps. That is wrong. At t=0, firing is fully determined by the first token. Per-token precision of (t==0)&(in_tok==X) is exactly 1.0 for b c e h k l m n o p r t v x z 1 2 3 and exactly 0.0 for a d f g i j q s u w y 0. The t=0 rate of 0.60 (18 of 30 tokens) is a token-identity split, not weak firing. It is about half of the predicate's 411k test false positives.

The predicate misses this systematic class. (phase<=1)&~((t==0)&isin(in_tok,OFF)), with OFF = a d f g i j q s u w y 0, raises test precision from 0.890 to 0.940 and F1 from 0.941 to 0.968. Recall (0.998) and mass recall (1.000) are unchanged. The agent's alternative (t>=1) dropped all t=0 steps, which is why it lost recall and was rejected.

After t=0, the effect of the 12-token set is weak. On original steps with t>=1, the feature fires at precision 0.928 when the input is in the set and 0.956 when it is not. Precision falls to about 0.86 when 4 or more of these tokens have already been seen. The leftover false positives are graded effects (also <DEL> at L>=7, precision 0.80, against 0.99 at L<=4), not a sharp class.

Claims that check out: the feature is essentially silent in the copy phase (8.1k tiny test misses, 0.0% of mass). <DEL> firing rate is about 0.88. Original-phase firing rate is about 0.96 for orig_idx 1-7. Activation mass peaks at t=2-4 (shares 0.179/0.190/0.175). The reported test scores reproduce: P 0.890, R 0.998, F1 0.941.
skeptic.revised_label: Pre-copy phase (original tokens + <DEL>). At t=0 it fires only when the first token is in a fixed set of 18 tokens; it is silent at t=0 when the first token is one of a d f g i j q s u w y 0.
